summary: Pre-market view: the composite risk score reads 53.16 (caution), 0.11 away from the previous published layer of 2026-10-13 at 53.05; the pressure sits in macro at 73.83, liquidity and credit at 59.91 and equity structure at 59.82, while volatility at 18.0 and cross-asset at 50.0 remain low. In the last completed US session (the 2026-10-13 close) the semiconductor complex split sharply: Nvidia closed at 228.520004 (up 0.9721 percent), AMD at 605.530029 (up 1.8999 percent) and Broadcom at 357.309998 (up 0.7273 percent), but Micron closed at 953.190002 (down 3.6247 percent) and Tesla fell 0.7407 percent, with semiconductor equipment down 2.3011 percent. Across the Asia session of 2026-10-14 A-share semiconductors kept falling, 688008.SH down 5.9524 percent, 300475.SZ down 5.239 percent and 688825.sh down 2.1068 percent; the memory theme reports only its 2 Korean constituents and shows a 0.8316 percent decline, while consumer electronics shows a 3.3007 percent gain from its 2 constituents in Hong Kong, China and Taiwan, China. Macro remains the main pressure: the 10-year real rate at 2.91 percent sits at the 99.68 percentile and the nominal 10-year at 5.24 percent at the 99.52 percentile, with VIX at 15.21, the dollar index at 121.6023 and high-yield OAS at 3.11 percent. Today's focus is the US CPI release at 2026-10-14T12:30Z, the last inflation print before the FOMC meeting. Note that the 22 sector and theme rows span two sessions: 19 rows describe the US session of 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-13 and 3 rows describe the Asia session of 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-14.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.5 with 4 of 8 production signals triggered; the 15 percent weight dimension contributes 7.5 points, the model's largest single driver, and is carried at a 0.8 proxy discount.

The 10-year real rate at 2.91 percent sits at the 99.68 percentile with a risk score of 99.68 and contributes 4.984 points; the nominal 10-year yield at 5.24 percent sits at the 99.52 percentile with a risk score of 99.04 and contributes 4.952 points. Together they are the core pressure behind the macro dimension at 73.83.

High-yield OAS at 3.11 percent (57.91 percentile) contributes 4.6328 points and investment-grade OAS at 0.83 percent (47.25 percentile) contributes separately; the liquidity and credit dimension scores 59.91, within which reverse repo at 0.275 maps to a risk score of 96.47 under the neutral-direction rule for a 3.8588 point contribution.

The equity structure dimension rose to 59.82 from 59.26 in the previous layer as the new-lows ratio moved to 0.1474 from 0.1218, with 23 qualifying names against 19; small-cap relative weakness is 9.5212 percent and semiconductor relative weakness 5.1213 percent.

The volatility dimension at 18.0 does not offset the macro pressure: VIX at 15.21 (25.0 percentile) and realized volatility at 9.5765 are both low, so the marginal change in risk is still priced by rates and credit rather than by sentiment.

supporting_signals.claim: Breadth holds at 0.5419 of the 155-name universe above its 200-day average; the new-highs ratio is 0.0513 with 8 qualifying names against a new-lows ratio of 0.1474 with 23 of 156.
The trend dimension scores 42.49: price sits 7.4871 percent above its 200-day average with a 0.1386 drawdown from the 52-week high and 3-month momentum of 3.0736.
The US AI complex is still absorbing bad news: on 2026-10-13 Nvidia closed at 228.520004 (up 0.9721 percent), AMD at 605.530029 (up 1.8999 percent) and Broadcom at 357.309998 (up 0.7273 percent).

The macro readings have been unchanged for several sessions: the effective fed funds rate at 3.88 percent, 2-year at 4.8 percent, 10-year at 5.24 percent, 5-year breakeven at 2.33 percent, 10-year breakeven at 2.33 percent and SOFR at 3.87 percent, so this round's change in risk comes from equity structure and measurement rather than from new rate information.

contradicting_signals.claim: The memory theme prints a 0.8316 percent decline built from only its 2 Korean constituents on 2026-10-14; its 6 US members, including Micron at 3.6247 percent lower on 2026-10-13, do not enter that step, so the figure is not a sector-wide reading.

The 3.3007 percent gain in consumer electronics likewise comes from only 2 of its 10 constituents, the Hong Kong, China and Taiwan, China lines, on 2026-10-14, and is not evidence of a broad electronics bid.

19 of the 22 sector and theme rows still describe the US session of 2026-10-12 to 2026-10-13 and only 3 rows describe the Asia session of 2026-10-13 to 2026-10-14, so reading the table in one pass mixes two sessions and two bases.

A-share semiconductors kept falling on 2026-10-14 (688008.SH down 5.9524 percent, 603986.SH down 4.4608 percent) while the US AI complex rose on 2026-10-13, so the two regional legs are not on the same cycle and should not be extrapolated from each other.

Model confidence is 0.9019, pulled down by a consistency factor of 0.6497 even though data quality is 1.0 and coverage is 0.93, which means the indicators disagree on direction and the reading is less interpretable than its coverage suggests.

what_changed_today: The composite risk score is 53.16, a change of 0.11 against the previous published layer at 53.05, so the level is essentially flat.
The equity structure dimension rose to 59.82 from 59.26 as the new-lows ratio moved to 0.1474 from 0.1218 and qualifying names rose to 23 from 19.

The A-share leg again carries a single-session base: 688825.sh at 46.0 (down 2.1068 percent), 603986.sh at 292.559998 (down 4.4608 percent) and 301308.sz at 259.970001 (down 4.1409 percent); the two-session cumulative artefact seen on 2026-10-13 is gone, so today's A-share declines are genuine single-session moves.

The theme table moves to a third form of the basket problem: 3 rows — memory, consumer electronics and robotics — now report the Asia session while the other 19 rows still report the US session, so two bases coexist inside one table.

The macro and credit readings did not advance again: 10-year at 5.24 percent, 2-year at 4.8 percent, the real rate at 2.91 percent, high-yield OAS at 3.11 percent and investment-grade OAS at 0.83 percent are identical to the previous layer, item by item.
watch_next: The US CPI release at 2026-10-14T12:30Z is the last inflation print before the FOMC meeting on 2026-10-27 to 2026-10-28.
Bank of America reports at 2026-10-14T12:00Z, TSMC at 2026-10-15T12:00Z, and PPI together with advance retail sales at 2026-10-15T12:30Z.
Watch whether the 10-year real rate at 2.91 percent and the nominal 10-year at 5.24 percent keep the macro dimension at 73.83.

Watch whether Micron's 3.6247 percent decline spreads across the US memory complex at the open, because the memory theme currently reports only its 2 Korean constituents and cannot give that signal in advance.
Watch VIX at 15.21 and high-yield OAS at 3.11 percent for any move that breaks the current low-volatility, tight-spread pairing.

bull_case.title: Bull case: a softer inflation print lets the AI complex lead
points: A core CPI print below expectations would relieve the macro pressure from the real rate at 2.91 percent and its 99.68 percentile reading, in a dimension currently scoring 73.83.
Volatility at 15.21 and realized volatility at 9.5765 remain low, leaving room for the AI complex, where Nvidia rose 0.9721 percent and AMD 1.8999 percent on 2026-10-13.

base_case.title: Base case: risk holds in the caution band near 53.16
points: The composite stays near 53.16 with the macro dimension at 73.83 and volatility at 18.0 offsetting each other.
Breadth stays near 0.5419 above the 200-day average and the regime stays goldilocks.

bear_case.title: Bear case: a hot inflation print pushes the 10-year real rate above 2.91 percent
points: A hot print would add to the 4.984 and 4.952 point contributions already carried by the 10-year real rate and the nominal 10-year.
A further widening of high-yield OAS beyond 3.11 percent would lift the liquidity and credit dimension above 59.91 and weaken the tight-spread assumption behind the goldilocks regime.
New lows, already 0.1474 of the universe with 23 qualifying names, would extend the equity structure dimension beyond 59.82.
